mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 57 degrees with clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail. The moon is in a Waxing Gibbous phase, and if you are up early, look to the west southwest near Mount Horeb at 3:25 AM to see the ISS travel high in the sky toward Madison near Home Depot.
There are no new emails to report, but you can head to the city website to review the latest police and civic updates covering recent service calls and general city operations.

There is plenty to do in Verona. Today, enjoy trivia at Hop Haus Brewing or Lake Lou-ee at the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, or more trivia at Paddy Mac's and The Bogey Factory.
In a summary of service calls from this past week, the Verona Police Department responded to incidents including a Department of Corrections warrant and a motor vehicle crash.

Today's flavor is the fan favorite OREO Cookie Cheesecake. Since we are currently closed, stop by when the doors open at 10 AM to grab your scoop. If you miss out today, tomorrow's flavor will be Chocolate Caramel Twist.
